domain_comparison_note: At h=.1 mm and fill height 3.5 mm: top-only crop changes liquid force +0.71%; x/y=+/-2.4/2.6 mm plus zmax4.5 changes +1.69%; smaller +/-1.9/2.1 changes +3.03%. Terminal resistance changes much less and alone does not verify the force field. Through 0.6 ms, the medium fluid case differs by 0.25% in liquid-weighted velocity L2 and 0.033% in alpha L2 from the full-height case. Later breakup/flight are not verified by that short comparison.

status.method: GPU finite-volume div J=0, J=sigma(-grad phi + u cross B0), current-controlled terminals, conductivity updated from accepted alpha; static CAD permanent-magnet B0. Forces drive the normal RunState fluid/interface engine.

cropped_fluid_comparison.limits: Same 0.1 mm grid, liquid fill height 3.5 mm, 80 A/400 us pulse, comparison through 0.6 ms. Full domain has closed outer walls; cropped domain has periodic z air return and truncated steel. Does not validate later pinch-off or flight-boundary interactions.
